name: RadioGroup
intent: Pick exactly one option from a short visible list. One piece: legend, options, message.
usage: Use RadioGroup for one choice from two to six options that should stay visible, like a billing cycle. Use Checkbox for independent yes/no choices. The legend names the group; hide it only when a heading already names it. labelPosition start moves the legend into the 234px label column beside the options, so the group lines up with the fields around it. Card layout suits choices that need a description. See contracts/radiogroup.json for the full contract. Inside a loading page it draws its own skeleton in place: a bar for the legend in its column and, for every option, its own circle and a bar for its words, in the column it will stand in, so nothing moves when it arrives. The page says loading once (FormPage's loading, carried on FormLayoutContext); it takes no loading prop of its own.

size.note: Circle 16 / 20 / 24 px, labels 12 / 14 / 16 px. Without a size it is md. A surrounding Density changes these sizes through the density tokens (Default values shown).

orientation.note: Horizontal only for two or three short labels. Card layout is always vertical.

layout.note: card = bordered rows, radio on the right, optional description and Badge.

hideLegend.note: Keeps the legend for screen readers, hides it on screen.

labelPosition.note: Where the legend sits. start puts it in a 234px column at the beginning, right-aligned, with the options beside it, the same column as a field's label. Inside a Form, the Form's labelPosition applies unless this is set. Under 554px a start legend goes back on top.

labelWidth.note: How wide its own start-label column is: sm 140px for a short name (Email, Status, Currency), md 234px, the product's own column, and lg 320px where the name runs longer than that. Only for a group standing on its own, outside a Form: inside one, let the Form's labelWidth set the column, or the labels down a column stop lining up. The options beside the label keeps its width at every step, and the point where the label goes back on top moves with the column: under 460px (sm), 554px (md) or 640px (lg). Read only with labelPosition="start"; with the label on top there is no column to size.

name.note: Optional. A name is generated when omitted.

error.note: Message under the group. Tints the radios red.

hint.note: Help text under the group. error replaces it.

options.note: Two to six. description and badge show in card layout. hideLabel keeps an option's label for screen readers only and shows the bare circle (list layout), for a choice whose row already says it.

useWhen: One choice from two to six visible options.
Settings where people compare options side by side.
doNot: Do not invent a Radio, RadioItem or RadioLegend cousin.
Do not use for independent yes/no choices. Use Checkbox.
Do not use for long lists of options.
Do not use to switch page panels.
Do not use an unstyled native radio.
Do not use hideLabel where people need to read the choice. It is for a radio whose row already says it, like a pick column in a table.
Do not draw your own grey bars over it while a page loads, and do not hide it. It skeletons itself in place, from the page's loading.
a11y: fieldset with a legend that names the group, whether the legend sits on top or in the label column.
Each option is a native input type=radio with a visible label; arrow keys move between options. With hideLabel the label is hidden text, so the radio keeps its name.
error sets aria-invalid on the fieldset and links the message with aria-describedby.
Disabled options stay readable but cannot be picked.
Focus ring on the circle for keyboard users.
snippet: <RadioGroup legend="Billing cycle" defaultValue="annual" options={[{ value: "monthly", label: "Monthly" }, { value: "annual", label: "Annual" }]} />

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: lg for a main decision, md for most forms, sm in dense filters and side panels.

examples.title: Horizontal
examples.usage: For two or three short labels in one row.

examples.title: Card
examples.usage: Bordered rows with the radio on the right. Use when each choice needs a short description or a Badge.

examples.title: Error and hint
examples.usage: Show error on the group when a required choice is empty or not allowed. Keep the message specific. Use hint for help text.

props.error: Select a billing cycle to continue.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.usage: Disable one option when it is not available for this account, or the whole group when a permission locks the choice.

examples.title: Hidden option label
examples.usage: hideLabel shows the bare circle and keeps the label for screen readers, for a radio whose row already says it.

examples.title: Legend at the start
examples.usage: labelPosition start puts the legend in the 234px label column, right-aligned, so the group lines up with the fields above and below it. Under 554px it goes back on top.

options.label: Priority
options.description: Answers in two hours, around the clock.
